note: Every job in exactly one lane, under Krish's 27 Oct 2026 lanes ruling (CHANGES.md, rule R94). What a lane may post comes from invariants/authority.json. engine/run/invariants.py:check_lanes proves every workflow and job is here once, and that no L0 job holds his hands or his eyes. There are no Claude routines and no Claude schedules of any kind (Krish, 29 Oct 2026): a new schedule is a GitHub Actions job in L0. Making (Canva assets, words, Buffer drafts) is done by interactive sessions and the PC automations below, under the same walls (docs/LANES.md, docs/TASTE.md); it is not a lane of its own. The North Star line is not an L0 job: its capture is the Substack Growth sources page, read only in the browser on Krish's PC by the "Growth: numbers" automation.

jobs.trigger: repository_dispatch cc-growth-directive from Control Center, 05:10 UTC daily; a 05:40 UTC backup that runs only when no dispatch run succeeded today; or by hand
may_write: Control Center engine reports and attempt journal entries, read back by digest
never: post, send, publish or spend
upload an artifact or log a figure from this public repository

jobs.trigger: every 30 minutes and by hand; acts only on go-lives Krish approved in Control Center, each draft only 5 to 90 minutes before it is due
may_write: Buffer posts whose bytes equal the signed manifest line, with their readback
never: release an unsigned or changed byte
schedule a draft more than 90 minutes before it is due
unschedule a post: one scheduled after a No is reported loudly for Krish
post to LinkedIn
retry an uncertain save blindly

may_write: the measurement report to Control Center
never: count a draft as an outcome
write a business figure into this public repository

jobs.trigger: 06:50 UTC daily, and by hand; measure also checks first
may_write: a pass or fail line naming which key is missing, never its value
never: print, rotate or create a key
copy a key out of the runner

jobs.trigger: repository_dispatch from a session or PC automation that saved the drafts (growth-go-live-manifest, growth-week-packet, growth-make-piece), and by hand (a dry run unless deliver is ticked)
may_write: a go-live, plan or check-in proposal to Control Center, built from Buffer drafts whose digest matches the dispatch's, with its readback
never: schedule or post anything
propose a slot whose draft differs from the dispatch's digest
put LinkedIn in as anything but his click
read a key
reach Control Center or any platform

jobs.trigger: a piece's article, assets and video recordings are ready
may_write: his approval of the board, bound to its digest
never: be pressed by the engine

jobs.trigger: each batch of derivatives, on or before 2026-11-29
may_write: his approval or amendment of the batch
never: be pressed by the engine
be skipped before 2026-11-29

jobs.trigger: each carousel, meme, opinion, reactive or other new-format item
may_write: his approval of that one item, bound to its digest
never: be pressed by the engine
approve a batch of new-format items at once

may_write: his signature on the week's go-live
never: be pressed by the engine

jobs.trigger: when he chooses, from the drafts the engine left him
never: be scheduled or posted by the engine

jobs.trigger: when a plan decision falls due
never: be bought or changed by the engine

may_write: account connections and keys, placed by him
never: be done by the engine
